title: Kazakh Latin (2021) — ASCII
description: Kazakh text in the April 2021 Latin alphabet reduced to ASCII: Ä→a, Ğ→g, I ı and İ i→i, Ñ→n, Ö→o, Ş→sh, Ū→u, Ü→u; Q, J, H, Y are kept as written (Äbışūly → Abishuly, Şoqan → Shoqan).
notes: A diacritic fold, not a passport system: Kazakh passports are produced from Cyrillic (see kk_passport, which gives K for Қ and ZH for Ж). Ş is folded to SH rather than ICAO's S because S already renders С.
In the 2021 alphabet I ı is the front vowel І and İ i is И/Й (unlike Turkish); both fold to i here.
The 2018 acute-accent letters (á ǵ ń ó ú) are also accepted; 2018 ý (=У) and the 2017 apostrophe spellings are not handled.
Russian-only letters are written tş (Ч), ts (Ц), ştş (Щ), io/iu/ia (Ё/Ю/Я) in 2021 Latin; they come out as tsh, ts, shtsh, io/iu/ia.
